content.text: Image point coordinates are in [y, x] format, where y is the vertical axis, x is the horizontal axis; their values are normalized from 0 to 1000, where [0 0] is the top left, [1000 1000] is the bottom right. The task of the robot is to screw the cap on the bottle. Where has the robot to move the cap? You have the following options. A: [638 481] B: [643 397] C: [453 562] D: [518 394] Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
